metadata.description: Claude plugins published by Will This Ever Work.

plugins.name: app-growth-calculator
plugins.description: Test whether a subscription app's paid growth pays back, what input must improve, and whether cash can cover the wait.

plugins.name: aso-keyword-intent
plugins.description: Sort a raw keyword list into App Store listing candidates, content topics and keywords to drop, with the reason for each.

plugins.name: directories-done
plugins.description: Prepare, approve once, submit and verify free directory listings for a released product, tool or site.

plugins.name: interview-story-coach
plugins.description: Build truthful interview stories from a job description and practise role-specific interviews.

plugins.name: make-my-product-clear
plugins.description: Rewrite existing product pages, app listings, and product descriptions so customers see why the product matters and what to do next.

plugins.name: review-intelligence
plugins.description: See what people love, hate and wish worked differently in apps they already use, with the App Store and Google Play reviews behind it.
